analysis: The host run succeeded. Training and candidate scores use only dot products between encoded states and shared item embeddings, with no item-scoring bias parameters or contributions. Convolution biases remain internal to the encoder. Validation HR@10 was 0.645; the best checkpoint was selected at epoch 10 of 30 completed epochs. No comparison run was provided, so the ranking effect of removing item biases cannot be established.
code_summary: Causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional shared item embeddings, learned position embeddings, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block contains two left-padded kernel-3 convolutions, a GELU/sigmoid gate, pre-layer normalization, dropout 0.2, and learned per-channel residual scaling initialized to 0.1. Padding is masked throughout. Final normalized states score training items directly; candidate scoring uses the last nonpadding state. MAXLEN=128, LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0, BATCH_SIZE=128. Existing interfaces are preserved.
